subject: Private deployment activation: on-prem checklist & role cue cards
messages:

Cc: BrightMed IT Team <it@brightmed.com>, Procurement (BrightMed) <procure@brightmed.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment kickoff: preflight checklist request

Jordan —

Thanks for the demo last week. BrightMed is ready to kick off the private (on-prem) deployment evaluation and we want to make sure we hit the right prerequisites from day one. Can you share the preflight checklist you use for on-prem activations plus any concrete lists we should provide (network ACLs, service account requirements, KMS integration notes, expected outbound IP ranges, etc.)?

High-level asks from our side:
- Network diagram template we can drop into our change ticket
- Minimal IAM bindings and service account naming convention
- KMS/HSM integration options and required certs/roles
- Estimated lead time for enclave provisioning and firewall window

We'd like to have these items captured by next Tuesday so our infra team can schedule a change window.

Thanks,
Alyssa Gomez
Senior IT Program Manager
BrightMed Health

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment kickoff: preflight checklist request

Alyssa —

Appreciate the clear list. I've attached our activation "cue cards" (PDF) and a compact ask-list (XLSX) that maps every network, identity, and compliance item to an owner and acceptance gate. Summary below — please review and tell us who on the BrightMed side will own each line so we can populate the mutual action plan.

Quick summary (high level):
- Network: inbound port whitelist for control-plane (443/ TLS), egress ranges (see sheet), VPN/Direct Connect or cross-connect requirements; we need a network diagram + change ticket 72h before planned provisioning.
- Identity: one service account per environment (prod/stage), recommended naming: brightmed-rw-<env>-svc, and a list of IAM principals for read/write ops.
- KMS: we support cloud-KMS and customer-managed HSM — provide key ARN and test-encrypt key material ahead of provisioning.
- Telemetry & logs: an S3/GCS bucket or a forwarder endpoint for audit logs; retention policy must be documented in the intake form.
- Certificates: if using mTLS for control plane, supply cert chain and CN mapping.

Proposed immediate asks for BrightMed to unblock us:
1) Network diagram (editable Visio/Draw.io)
2) List of service accounts + admin contacts
3) Proposed 3-day window for provisioning (dates)
4) Contact for KMS/HSM integration (security lead)

I've looped in Ben for SLA gate questions and Monica for the runbook/validation checklist. Vivek is our onsite ops lead for cross-connects and will run the network acceptance tests.

Next steps: once we get the diagram + service accounts, we'll run an internal pre-acceptance check and schedule the provisioning slot. If that sounds good, can you confirm owners on the items above?

Best,
Jordan Blake
Solutions Lead — Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_onprem_activation_cuecards_v1.pdf (stub), brightmed-network-asklist-20261022.xlsx (stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Sat, 24 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment kickoff: preflight checklist request

Adding a couple of operational hold-points we enforce for Dedicated/on-prem activations — call these SLA gates so BrightMed is clear what triggers approvals:

1) Network gate (GATE-NET): pass connectivity, TLS validation, and egress verification. Vivek to run tests and publish a testrun report.
2) KMS gate (GATE-KMS): crypto key import/validation. Security must sign off after a test encrypt/decrypt.
3) Secrets & SSO gate (GATE-SECS): confirm that secret rotation and audit log forwarding are configured.
4) Smoke & Load gate (GATE-SMOKE): smoke test plus a 30-min baseline traffic run to validate latency SLOs.

Operational notes:
- If BrightMed requires an airgap variant we need 4 additional days for image hardening and cert provisioning.
- For change windows, provide a 72h lead so we can staff on-call and reserve cross-connects.
- Pricing note: expedited provisioning inside a 5-business-day window will incur a one-time acceleration fee (we've already discussed pricing in HS-394821).

Jordan/Monica: can you add these gates into the cue cards and mark the expected artifact for each (e.g., testrun report URL, KMS ARN, audit-forwarder endpoint)?

Ben
VP, Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference
